materials.title: Fictional Civic Accountability Notes
materials.content: Public accountability means officials explain decisions and accept scrutiny. Transparent budgets allow communities to monitor public spending. These fictional notes are for software testing only.

materials.title: Fictional Offline Learning Notes
materials.content: Offline learning allows students to practice when network connection is unavailable. A learner can save local notes, attempt practice quizzes and review progress without internet. This fictional passage makes no claim about learning outcomes.
